title: Resolve the Undertow schema catalogue from the VIXEN WSL preset
body: The initial vixen-wsl configure had no schema catalogue path and failed before the test build. I had to reconfigure with -DVIXEN_SCHEMA_CATALOG=/home/liory/projects/undertow/core/src/Undertow.Authoring/Schema/schemas.json. Make the preset discover the sibling Undertow schema catalogue or expose a documented repo-local setting so a fresh VIXEN worktree configures without a manual absolute path.

title: Generate C++ GPU-test push-constant mirrors from the shared shader ABI
body: The shared GLSL push-constant payload ends at byte 92 and std430 rounds the range to 96, but three RenderGraph test fixtures independently mirrored it as 92 bytes. Validation emitted VUID-VkComputePipelineCreateInfo-layout-10069 until I manually appended _pad1 and changed the C++ size assertion in test_body_instance_occlusion_reject.cpp, test_editor_document_render.cpp, and test_tier_crossing_lod_residency.cpp. Generate or share this ABI instead of synchronizing duplicate structs by hand.

title: Match test SPIR-V target environment to the Vulkan runtime
body: The BodyInstanceRayMarch test shader is compiled with glslc --target-env=vulkan1.3 in test_critical_nodes.cmake, producing SPIR-V 1.6. The selected Dozen device validates it under Vulkan 1.2 semantics and emits VUID-VkShaderModuleCreateInfo-pCode-08737 on each render, even though the GPU tests exit zero. Derive the compiler target from the runtime contract or set a compatible target for this test shader.

title: Let the tier-crossing GPU harness address arbitrary child octree indices
body: The 30-AU fixture resolves its active tier to config slot 4, but the existing headless GPU harness did not support the natural child index 5 in this fixture. I manually aliased the child payload into config slot 1 and rewrote the active TierRef entries while preserving the active tier and table base. Support arbitrary childOctreeIndex values in the fixture so tests can exercise the production concatenated-pool contract without test-only index rewrites.

title: Provide a canonical launcher for WSL Dozen headless tests
body: Launching test_rendergraph_criticalnodes_gpurender2 from the worktree root with the documented VK_ICD_FILENAMES and VK_LAYER_PATH produced vkCreateInstance=-9 for all eight tests. Launching the same binary from VIXEN/ with those environment paths passed. Provide a launcher or documented working directory and retain loader diagnostics so this invocation sensitivity is reproducible.

title: Write shareable PNG captures directly from headless GPU tests
body: The 30-AU headless test writes its readback as P6 PPM. This environment had no magick, convert, ffmpeg, or vips executable, so I wrote a one-off stdlib PPM-to-PNG encoder to add a browser-viewable report artifact. Add PNG output to the capture helper or a standard in-repo conversion path.
